benchmark_method: Direct g++ -O3: independent DOM parse() timing + direct stage1()/stage2() timing; 3-repetition medians; 1e9 bytes/s

hypotheses: H1: quantify A1/A0 overhead for small inputs around 512B; 512B is NOT the dispatch threshold
H2: A1/A0 and A2/A0 change around exact 4095/4096/4097-byte dispatch threshold
H3: A2/sparse8 competition in dense, numbers, UTF8 and escaping mixes
H4: moving non-ASCII/escape/structural payload after first 512B weakens quick classification only on inputs >=4096B
H5: A2/A0 changes mainly in true Stage1 rather than Stage2
exploration_design.measurement_design: new test90 JSON, paired same-trial five-mode measurements, randomized/reversed order
